theme.description: Premium, tactical, cyber-modern dark theme designed for tech skill development. Emphasizes focus, gamification, and high contrast.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous Spacing Philosophy with Control Room Grids

components.progress_bar: Animated width expansion with neon orange glow.
components.level_badge: Pops in with scale (0 to 1) and continuous subtle pulsing glow.

button.primary: bg-[#FF6200] text-white font-medium px-6 py-3 rounded-lg hover:bg-[#FF7B29] transition-all
button.secondary: bg-[#2A2A2A] text-white border border-[#444444] px-6 py-3 rounded-lg hover:bg-[#333333] hover:border-[#FF6200]/50 transition-all
button.ghost: text-[#CCCCCC] hover:text-[#FF6200] px-4 py-2 rounded-lg transition-colors

components.input: bg-[#1F1F1F] border border-[#2A2A2A] text-white rounded-lg px-4 py-3 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#FF6200]/50 focus:border-[#FF6200] transition-all
components.floating_chat: fixed bottom-6 right-6 w-14 h-14 bg-[#FF6200] rounded-full shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(255,98,0,0.6)] flex items-center justify-center cursor-pointer hover:scale-110 transition-transform z-50
components.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='login-button')

images.description: Abstract orange light streaks on black background, perfect for cyber-modern hero sections.
Dark modern programming workspace, to be used in Onboarding or Connect/Social sections.
Professional developer portrait, ideal for Mentors directory or Connect/Social feed.

pages_and_features.onboarding: Goal selection (Backend/Frontend/AIML), personality quiz. Generates personalized roadmap.
pages_and_features.dashboard: Displays streak, level badge, XP, roadmap preview, and daily activity. Uses Control Room grid.
pages_and_features.my_roadmap: Vertical timeline with animated orange progress line.
pages_and_features.practice_problems: Coding interface with 'I'm Stuck' AI chat widget and YouTube integration.
pages_and_features.contests: Leaderboards with gamified row highlights for top users.
pages_and_features.group_discussion: Grid of My Groups leading to detailed group views (tasks, chat, multi-agent AI, Google Meet integration, completion certificates).
pages_and_features.mentors: Directory of tech mentors with booking capabilities.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the pure #0A0A0A or #000000 background.
Implement GSAP for all scroll reveals and progress bar animations.
Apply hover scale 1.03 and orange glow to all interactive cards and primary buttons.
Use Phosphor icons for sidebar navigation and actions.
Use JetBrains Mono for all code-related or tabular data to emphasize the cyber-modern developer feel.
Ensure all data-testids are present for automated testing.
Use raw HTML/Tailwind for marketing layouts and Shadcn UI heavily customized for the app dashboard features.
